contents.inscription: Wherever flowers grow in a ring, a wisp comes at night. Each is a creature of one element, and frail: meet it with a blade and it falls quickly. But its spells strike hard at anyone who cannot cast. Slain, it drops arcane stones.
contents.description: Every page is in the same careful hand. The first reads: for my children, and theirs.
